settlement_source: United States Congress (Source Agency per SEATSCONGRESS); congress.gov / senate.gov membership
settlement_variable: Number of U.S. Senate seats held by Democratic Party (including independents caucusing with Democrats) on Feb 1, 2027 at 10:00 AM ET (start of 120th Congress). Market = exactly N seats.
tie_handling: n/a (bucketed integer outcomes). Treatment of vacant seats unspecified: unknown.
trading_close_vs_settlement: Last trading time = expiration time (Feb 1 2027 10:00 ET; markets show close 2027-02-01T15:00Z). Settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review. If Feb 1 data unavailable, next date data is available.
early_close_or_void_clauses: can_close_early=1 flag; contract text has NO accelerated-determination clause (unlike SENATEPARTY/GOVPARTY). Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(c)) at Kalshi sole discretion. Revisions after expiration not counted.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'hold 48 seats in the 120th Congress' vs rules: measured at a single instant (Feb 1 2027 10:00 ET), not throughout the Congress
Independents caucusing with Democrats count as Democrats (secondary rule), not obvious from title
Underlying text says composition of House and Senate; this series' markets are Senate only
toxicity_flags: Insider prohibitions (vote tallies, campaign staff, decision desks, Congress staff) imply informed flow around election results
Outcome largely determined by Nov 2026 election results public months before Feb 1 2027 close; residual risk from recounts, vacancies, appointments, party switches (thin tails at 0.002-0.003)
notes: SEATSCONGRESS.pdf read in full. Sample: 48-seat bucket bid 0.002 ask 0.003, 24 open markets, 24h volume ~1.86M. Vacancies/appointments between election and Feb 1 unspecified (unknown).
